## Teaching points

1. Distention and obstipation with a twisted sigmoid on CT require urgent treatment even without severe pain.
2. Endoscopic detorsion is appropriate when there is no suspected ischemia or perforation; these findings instead require surgery.
3. Decompression does not eliminate recurrence risk. The receiving team should discuss definitive management.
